checks.scope: published masses and synthetic single-band transport
checks.claim: All SKBcal masses in Tables 1 and 2, SI acoustic transport at finite nonparabolicity, the SPB limit and equivalent-valley scaling.
checks.provenance: Four SI constants imported from seeband_core.math_module. The table targets are the published SKBcal masses. The synthetic comparisons use dimensional velocity/DOS moments and an independent SPB Fermi-integral reference.
checks.limitations: Isolated, isotropic intravalley acoustic band with prescribed amplitude. Published tables have N=K=1. N>1 and absolute conductivity are synthetic checks. Mixed-channel weights, empirical amplitude calibration, production calculations and fit behavior remain open.

checks.claim: A finite admissible interval for a free Fermi energy gives indistinguishable Seebeck curves. For noiseless data the witness reaches the global lower bound of zero squared residual.
checks.limitations: The profile minimum follows from exact charge invariance and zero loss. Outside-gap controls hold nuisance parameters fixed. This run does not estimate uncertainty or exercise the application optimizer or API.

checks.claim: Fermi-reference global mass scaling and informative Hall under empirical conductivity amplitudes. Three-band longitudinal sensitivity to ratios through charge balance, and truncation by chosen weight bounds.

slice_gates.criterion: Mean squared scaled longitudinal residual <=1. Hall additionally requires its own mean squared scaled residual <=1. Bounds are applied separately to the longitudinal subset.

checks.provenance: Branch design harness, SciPy charge balance, independent radial-k charge check and standalone SPB transport integrals. See stdout for runtime versions.
checks.limitations: The three-band empirical weight law is proposed, including its ionized specialization. The grid holds the other coordinates prescribed. Counts under illustrative residual scales do not establish fitted intervals, global identifiability or production support.
